items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I remember that Avon Long and Billie Holiday and a lot of the artists had appeared.

ctx.x: In about 1946 -- '45 or '46 when I first moved up here in the neighborhood, there was a theater up on Boston Road near here. The McKinley Theater -- which previously had presented some revues.
I remember that Avon Long and Billie Holiday and a lot of the artists had appeared. They even did some so-called legitimate productions up
